question: Should OpenClaw adopt public purpose-specific memory role slots in core, or keep the current single recommended memory slot and rely on companion plugin hooks for extra memory behavior?
rationale: The request is technically grounded, but it adds new public config/API semantics in a product area where VISION.md still says memory is a special single-plugin slot and convergence on one recommended default is planned.

options.title: Review role-slot architecture
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 as the implementation candidate and require conflict resolution plus upgrade proof before landing.

options.title: Keep single-slot strategy
options.body: Decide that memory remains one active runtime owner and route Honcho, Hindsight, Memory Wiki, and similar capabilities through existing companion plugin hooks or narrower SDK seams.

options.title: Split narrower groundwork
options.body: Defer the full role taxonomy and first land smaller owner-normalization, diagnostics, or SDK hooks if those unblock plugin composition with less config surface.

recommendation.title: Review role-slot architecture
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 as the implementation candidate and require conflict resolution plus upgrade proof before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent memory/plugin runtime work and related issue closure history make this the strongest routing candidate from the observed history.
